internal_alignment: Writing W.1.2: write an informative piece that names a topic, supplies facts, and closes the piece. W.1.8: recall information from experience to answer a question. The child picks one how-to (Page 1), draws its four steps in order with First, Next, Then, Last (Page 2), writes one sentence per step using the time words (Page 3), and closes the book with a closing line, a helpful tip, and a self-check (Page 4). Sentence frames fade across the pack: a starter on the first two steps, open lines on the last two, per the user's standing refinement that writing packs gradually reduce frames and provide genuine independent writing.
pack: Grade 1 Writing: How-To Books: Writing the Steps

pages_detail.activities: The child circles one picture or writes their own how-to idea, writes the book title starting with 'How to', lists what they need on three handwriting rows, and draws what it looks like when they are done.
pages_detail.title: Pick Your How-To

pages_detail.activities: Four large numbered drawing frames, First, Next, Then, Last, in a 2x2 grid. The child draws the four steps of their how-to in order, one picture per frame.
pages_detail.title: Order the Steps

pages_detail.activities: Four numbered writing panels matching Page 2 by number, word, and colour. One spacious handwriting row per step. Steps 1 and 2 start with 'First, ' and 'Next, ' printed on the line; steps 3 and 4 are open lines where the child writes the full sentence with 'Then' and 'Last'.
pages_detail.title: Write the Steps

pages_detail.activities: The child writes a closing line starting with 'Now you can', writes one helpful tip in the lightbulb panel, and ticks a four-item checklist: named the how-to, steps in order, included a true fact or helpful tip, closed the book.
pages_detail.title: Close It and Check It
